assessmentQuestionVersion.name: Application form 3
assessmentQuestionVersion.questionText:
Length of a licence:

A new licence is valid for 5 years if:

  • it’s the first time you’ve had a firearms licence
  • your firearms licence expires before you apply for a new one
  • your previous firearms licence was revoked or surrendered (section 25A of the Arms Act 1983).

If you reapply before your current licence expires, your new licence will be valid for 10 years.
